thesis: PRE-CLOSE (15:00 ET) update for the live 2026-08-04 session on the deterministic snapshot asOf 2026-08-04T18:30:25.272Z (bars updated 2026-08-04T18:30:15.835Z, 291 live series, freshSymbolCount 291, 0 carried / 0 missing, last completed daily bar 8/3; 22 option chains updated 2026-08-04T18:30:19.817Z, freshSymbolCount 22, 0 carried / 0 missing; marketClosed false). WHAT CHANGED SINCE THE MORNING WINDOW: the breakout EXTENDED again and the two stale caveats the morning flagged both RESOLVED in the tape's favor — but a fresh caution flag returned in their place. The last completed daily bar is still 8/3, yet the live 8/4 session pushed higher: SPY prints 772.4, a fresh 52-week high (pctFrom52wHigh 0), +3.65% above its 50-day (~745.1), +10.58% over its 200-day (~698.4), holding a bull-stack, and holding above its VWAP 767.5 (intraday-tape-lab fresh, asOf 2026-08-04T18:30:22Z, Trend day up under Retail-driven control, 61 bars, gap +0.39%). RESOLVED CAVEAT 1 — the dealer chain RE-CONFIRMED and the walls MOVED UP: gamma-trading-lab and options-structure-lab (asOf 2026-08-04T14:14:26Z, a ~10:14 ET snapshot with spot 772.02 essentially aligned with live spot) now read SPY POSITIVE dealer gamma, signed net GEX +1.50B, gamma FLIP 761.45, PUT WALL 755, CALL WALL 775, front expected move ±6.48 (~±0.84%), atmIV 22.68%, 3 expiries, scenario pin-to-maxpain, conviction patient, hold same-session-fade — so live spot 772.4 now sits comfortably BETWEEN the 761.45 flip and the 775 call wall (positive gamma, room to the pin rather than pinned against a stale cap). RESOLVED CAVEAT 2 — SPMO RECLAIMED its 50-day: SPMO 151.61 is now +0.70% ABOVE its 50-day (~150.5), the last momentum leader to complete its 50-day reclaim (mom5 +7.56, mom63 +12.94, mom252 +35.02, +17.69% over its 200-day). QQQ 723.87 (+1.28% above its 50-day ~714.6, mom5 +7.16, mom21 +0.15), VGT 120.46 (+3.37% above ~116.5) and XLK 187.36 (+2.34% above ~183.0) hold their reclaims. MSFT holds its surge to 497.19 (+23.59% above its 50-day ~402.3, +15.07% above its 200-day ~432.0, mom5 +26.4) with its maStack still TANGLED though mom252 -4.38 stays negative, so the bull-stack is not yet rebuilt. THE NEW CAUTION FLAG: VIX ticked UP to 16.51 (band VIX 16.5) from the morning's 15.86 EVEN AS SPY made a higher high, and atmIV rose to 22.68% with the expected move widening to ±6.48 — the up-VIX-into-strength divergence has RE-ASSERTED (the morning's easing reversed). It remains well under 20 and under the +3 regime-change threshold, so the calm regime is intact, but hedging is being bid into the new high. WHAT STILL HAS NOT CONFIRMED: (1) it is INTRADAY, not a completed daily CLOSE — the plan still requires a decisive close that HOLDS at/above the new high; the pin-to-maxpain dealer read plus the 775 call-wall magnet argue the day can drift toward the pin rather than extend, and an intraday high can fade into the close. (2) BREADTH IS STILL NARROW: market-heatmap-lab (fresh, asOf 2026-08-04T18:30:25Z) reads 57.53% of 135 constituents positive vs a 60% threshold (margin -2.47), UNCHANGED from the morning — a higher index high on the SAME sub-60% breadth, so the melt-up stays megacap-led rather than broadening. Fresh owner reads keep voting risk-on/cyclical: sector-research-lab (asOf 2026-08-04T18:30:23Z) reads Rotate toward XLY as XLF weakens — XLY Improving-up (rsMom 100.41, accel +1.0, quad I), XLK the leader Improving (rsMom 100.75, accel +0.66, +20.48% over its 200-day), MAGS Improving (rsMom 100.51), funding from Weakening financials/health/industrials (XLF 98.79 / XLV 97.69 / XLI 99.98), energy (XLE, accel -3.2) Lagging, with XLC/XLP/XLRE/XLU Lagging and XLB Basing-up. etf-momentum-lab (asOf 2026-08-04T13:30Z) ranks VGT first (28.25%, 13 scored) ahead of JMOM/SPMO/XSMO/QQQ; global-rotation-lab (asOf 2026-08-04T13:30Z) keeps EWS Singapore first (82.4, EWA next, 13 scored); real-assets-lab (asOf 2026-08-04T13:30Z) keeps CPER copper the lead (64.5) with BTC 46.7, DBA 43.7, GLD 22.1, SLV 0 — an industrial-metals lead, still no precious-metal haven. options-flow-feed-lab (fresh, asOf 2026-08-04T14:14:27Z) stays overtly call-heavy (86.51% call fraction, $7.37B call vs $1.15B put across 12 tickers, 2453 contracts cleared the $250k/30-day bar, top AVGO 420 calls $11.5M on 5.1x OI at 3DTE, then NVDA 212.5C / AAPL 310C at 1DTE) — a single-day, 0DTE-skewed bullish lean, context only. swing-structure-lab (Bull-stacked 20>50>200, fast 746.01 / slow 697.91, Double-bottom qualified) and volatility-sizing-lab (NORMAL, cond vol 14.56%, percentile 67.46, throttle x1.03) are carried 8/3 reads that do not yet reflect the 8/4 tape. bond-regime-lab cannot make the credit or duration call this run (the yield curve, real yields and inflation break-evens are not on file); its high-yield-versus-investment-grade price ratio strengthening through 8/3 is a mild risk-on credit tell only. technical-analysis-decision-lab published its data foundation but its owner five-gate model is not implemented, so it does not feed the brief yet. PLAN for the rest of the 8/4 session, tomorrow-first: HOLD the structural core and the existing beta tranche and do NOT chase the extended spike into the close on narrow breadth with VIX ticking up — two of the three morning add-conditions (SPMO back above its 50-day, dealer walls re-confirmed) are now MET, but the third (breadth above 60%) is not, and there is still no completed close. Convert the tranche from hold to ADD only on a decisive SPY daily CLOSE that HOLDS at/above the new high WITH heatmap breadth pushing above ~60%; ROTATE toward XLY funded from Weakening financials/health/industrials on the fresh read, keeping XLC/XLP/XLRE/XLU out and sizing the XLK leg only while it holds rsMom >100; HOLD MSFT and do NOT chase 497.19 — let the maStack finish repairing to a bull-stack on daily closes holding above the 200-day (~432.0); and keep a MINIMAL event-insurance residual overnight into July NFP 8/7 8:30am ET — with VIX now ticking back UP into the high the hedging-into-strength worry has returned, so run the rest off only once SPY posts a completed CLOSE at/through the new high with dealers still positive-gamma above the 761.45 flip and breadth above 60%. Persistence by distinct COMPLETED daily bars: the de-risk theme ran ~15 (7/09->7/29); the risk-on reversal is 4 completed bars (7/29, 7/30, 7/31, 8/3); the 8/4 session is a live in-progress breakout that would print a 5th completed bar only if it holds into the close — do not count it yet. Catalysts, nearest-first: whether SPY's intraday breakout HOLDS into a completed daily close at/above the new high (or fades back toward the 761.45 flip / the 775 call-wall pin), whether breadth clears 60%, the official 7/29 FOMC statement/path (still unverified — re-pull), then July NFP 8/7 8:30am ET and the BLS preliminary benchmark revision 8/28.
